name: Siti Aminah binti Rahman
bio:
Siti Aminah's journey into motorsports began unexpectedly during her apprenticeship at a local engineering firm. Initially assigned to mundane tasks, her meticulous attention to detail and knack for problem-solving quickly caught the eye of a senior mechanic who was moonlighting for a karting team. He took her under his wing, introducing her to the intricate world of chassis fabrication and engine tuning. 

Over the years, Siti has honed her skills, becoming a highly sought-after fabricator within the Malaysian karting scene. She prides herself on her practical approach, always seeking the most efficient and robust solutions. Her calm demeanor under pressure and knack for mentoring younger team members have earned her the respect and admiration of her colleagues. She believes that the key to a successful build is understanding the driver's needs and translating that into tangible improvements on the track. Her commitment is to provide the best possible equipment, focusing on reliability and performance.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low bun, with a few stray strands framing her face
physical.description: A woman of medium build, Siti possesses a quiet strength evident in her steady hands and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations
Insists on using traditional hand tools whenever possible, believing they provide a better feel for the materials
Has a habit of humming traditional Malaysian folk songs while working.
